items.stem: Why does the field of embodied AI argue that a physical body matters for intelligence?

options.text: Acting in and sensing the physical world grounds learning and shapes what skills are needed
options.rationale: Correct: embodiment ties perception and action together, grounding intelligence in interaction.

options.text: Because a body makes the robot run its code faster
options.rationale: Embodiment is about grounded interaction, not processor speed.

options.text: Because software cannot run without a humanoid shape
options.rationale: Software runs on many forms; the claim is about grounded learning, not shape necessity.

options.text: Because a body removes the need for any perception
options.rationale: Embodiment increases the role of perception, it does not remove it.

items.explanation: Correct: embodiment ties perception and action together, grounding intelligence in interaction.

items.stem: Which TWO are genuine challenges specific to humanoid robots? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Maintaining dynamic balance while walking on two legs
options.rationale: Correct: bipedal balance is a hard, actively researched problem.
Correct: fine manipulation with high-DoF hands is a core challenge.

options.text: Being unable to store any digital data
options.rationale: Data storage is not a humanoid-specific challenge.

options.text: Humanoids are already more capable than humans at all physical tasks
options.rationale: This overstates current abilities; it is not a challenge statement and is false.

items.explanation: Correct: bipedal balance is a hard, actively researched problem.

items.stem: A humanoid is told 'bring me the red cup from the table'. What capability links the words to the right physical action?

options.text: Grounding language in perception and action so the referenced object maps to a real grasp
options.rationale: Correct: grounding connects the instruction to perceived objects and executable actions.
Connectivity does not ground language in the physical scene.

options.text: A louder speaker to confirm the command
options.rationale: Audio output does not link words to the correct physical action.
Power capacity does not perform language grounding.

items.explanation: Correct: grounding connects the instruction to perceived objects and executable actions.
